comprehension.rawAnswers:
1. Yes, I exported the encrypted backup, and the wallet confirmed it ("Encrypted backup exported", backup-exported now true).
2. The only gas figure I saw was "native-gas-wei: 0" in the export result, which most likely means the wallet holds 0 native gas; I earlier read it as "no gas charged", and that may have been a misreading.
3. I didn't test this, but with 0 gas a fresh on-chain withdrawal you start yourself could not pay its network fee and so shouldn't be expected to go through until gas is added; only the automatic tower-backed recovery is reported as moving your money.

args.summary: Provider H1 is offline. Activity shows a protection check active on $145.00, with a dispute active and tower enrolled; the wallet's protection status reads "Provider offline — moving your Cash back to your wallet automatically." No backup existed, so I exported the encrypted backup (confirmed: "Encrypted backup exported", backup-exported now true). The wallet did not ask for network gas at any point; the export result showed native-gas-wei 0, which I read as no gas charged, though the wallet doesn't label it. Recovery is in progress, not finished: the provider is still offline, the dispute is still open, and I did not run wait-settlement, so I can't confirm the $145.00 has settled back yet. Cash still shows $145.00.
